t: I Vowed to Buy (Almost) Nothing New for My Baby. Here’s How I Did It.
s: October 21, 2025 - My son is now 4. I still buy as few new things as possible for him. It has made me a happier, less stressed parent. Alongside a lot of good deals, I’ve found connection with other parents.
